purpose: Proposed regression specifications; not executions or historical outputs
data_status: All numerical profiles and candidate names are synthetic. No real NBA player or Pokemon ratings are asserted.

profile_contract.scale: Fixed shared 0-100 mapped attribute scale, before any per-profile centering
profile_contract.scope: Illustrative six-axis fixture schema, not a claim about the current app's complete attribute schema
profile_contract.ranking: Ascending equal-weight root-mean-square gap for these fixtures only
profile_contract.threshold_status: Provisional until measured. Expected judgments are qualitative design targets; these fixtures do not establish cutoff values.
profile_contract.flatness_policy: Suppress centered shape claims when either profile lacks meaningful spread; exact zero centered norm must not produce NaN or a fabricated similarity.

expected_judgments.shape: Identical centered pattern; insufficient for a close comparison
expected_judgments.required_message: No close comparison in this pool. Closest available: high_parallel.

cases.rationale: A shared pattern at a radically different level must not be promoted to a good match merely because it ranks first.

expected_judgments.shape: No reliable directional style claim for the query
expected_judgments.invariant: Tiny perturbations cannot produce confident opposing archetype labels.

cases.rationale: Centering can amplify tiny differences into strong shape scores. Near-equal absolute profiles should remain close even when centered directions reverse.

expected_judgments.invariant: No division-by-zero failure, NaN display, or fabricated perfect style score.

cases.rationale: An undefined shape statistic must not prevent a valid absolute match.

expected_judgments.forbidden_implication: Identical real-world playing style or guaranteed equivalence

cases.rationale: A genuinely nearby candidate should receive positive quality language, with its scope limited to mapped attributes.

expected_judgments.required_message: No close comparison in this pool; label any displayed winner closest available.
expected_judgments.invariant: Changing rank or pool size alone cannot improve a fixed pair's quality judgment.

cases.rationale: A fallback must remain honest even when every eligible candidate is distant.

expected_judgments.forbidden_description: Same overall style or close scoring comparison inferred from shooting alone

cases.rationale: Specific trait resemblance can coexist with a poor whole-profile match; scoring additionally needs dunk and layup evidence.

inputs.stage: Controlled common-scale inputs to the mapping blend, before downstream transformations

expected_judgments.shooting_source: Special Attack; changing Attack alone must not substitute it
expected_judgments.layup_weights: Unresolved; assert both sources participate without inventing a historical split
expected_judgments.scoring_scope: Include layups alongside shooting and dunking

cases.rationale: Protects the explicit shooting choice, layup addition, and the latest retrieved handles correction over the earlier 70/15/15 suggestion. Blend expectations are not claims about final displayed ratings.
Preserves the later explicit presentation correction even for an otherwise excellent comparison.

remaining_uncertainty: No production quality or flatness thresholds have been measured.
Current normalization, complete axis list, eligibility, grouping, and implemented fixes were not inspected.
Layup weights and mapping transformation order are not established by the retrieved evidence.
Keyword searches were bounded and sometimes truncated; unreturned later corrections remain possible.
Referenced historical screenshots were unavailable; historical named examples are not numerical fixtures.
